rooms.name: A Mystical Gateway from the Mountains
rooms.desc:
Just as you feel as though your about to pass out from all the climbing
up the mountain, and the ever decreasing amount of oxygen to breathe, you
notice the air strangely becomes easier to breathe again.  you realize your
actually walking on the clouds all around you, as they begin to change to
a veritable kaleidoscope of colors.  Your senses tell you conflicting 
things.  Maybe your still on the mountain, maybe not, one thing is for sure,
your very far away from solid ground.  There is a sense of peace here.

rooms.name: Before the Elysium Kingdom
rooms.desc:
Before you looms a breathtakingly beautiful kingdom.  Light plays across
every miniscule facet and face of the structures, making the buildings seem
alive with the fire of life and goodness.  At your feet lies the moat, but
instead of water, there is only air, giving you second thoughts about
"swimming"  to the other side.  Fortunately for you, the drawbridge in the
gateway is open.

rooms.name: Elysium town center south
rooms.desc:
You are standing inside the enormous gates looming into the sky to your
south.  All about you is a decadent glamour and beauty of nature, magic,
and architecture.  Light plays across numerous gold, silver, and crystal
surfaces, ranging from small items to the very walls themselves.  Lovely
flowering plants grow from the very clouds beneath your feet that you notice
have taken on a solidity much like that of the ground.  All manner of strange
and exotic beasts wander the streets on some errand or other.  To your east
and west lie several buildings, and northward leads to an enormous castle.

rooms.name: Western market street
rooms.desc:
Your standing on the main path through the southern section of the Elysium
town center.  Crystal and white marble constructs adorned with gold and silver
loom up all about you, shining light everywhere.  An occasional exotic tree
or bush sprouts up from the clouds beneath you, adding to the peaceful
atmosphere here.  To your north lies a peaceful hut.

rooms.name: Eastern market street
rooms.desc:
Your standing on the main path of the southern section of the Elysium
town center.  Crystal and white marble constructs adorned with gold and silver
loom up all about you, shining light everywhere. An occasional exotic tree
or bush sprouts up from the clouds beneath you, adding to the peaceful
atmosphere here.  To your north a multi colored hut invites you to explore
it's mysterious secrets.  To the south, you faintly smell several pleasant
smells.

rooms.name: Eastern market street
rooms.desc:
Your standing on the main path of the southern section of the Elysium
town center.  Crystal and white marble constructs adorned with gold and silver
loom up all about you, shining light everywhere.  An occasional exotic tree
or bush sprouts up from the clouds beneath you, adding to the peaceful
atmosphere here.  To your north lies the local scriber.  To the south lies a
nondescript hut.

rooms.name: Kir-lan's parchments
rooms.desc:
Variously colored parchments and scrolls are neatly stacked all about you.
Kir-lan, the scriber, smiles and watches you with indifference out of the
corner of his eye.

rooms.name: Room of illusions
rooms.desc:
Swirling patterns of rich colors surround you and seem to adjust to you as
you are enveloped briefly in a soothing embrace.  You suddenly find yourself
exactly where you want to, surrounded by all the things you want, and all the
attention of those whom you like spending your time with most.  Every stray
pleasant thought you have becomes tangible, real, and so life-like, you almost
lose yourself in the miracle of it all.  Just as you have everything you want
and start to leave, everything slowly fades away as you approach the exit.
Hmmph.  If only a location specific paradise, it was good while it lasted...

rooms.name: A pleasant room
rooms.desc:
Upon entering this room, your senses are pervaded by all manner of sweet
and pleasant smells.  From the smell of fresh pine, to baked cookies, 
whatever pleases you most, seems to stand out.  Strangely, there is no source
of the smells except possibly your own imagination; as if all of what you
experience is what you want most...

rooms.name: A crystal hut
rooms.desc:
Light flows throught the walls in this spacious yet modest little crystal
abode.  Here, as in many other areas in the kingdom, teh clouds themselves
form a pillowy floor beneath your feet.  Off in one corner of the room is a 
secure see through area in the floor, showing the ground far far below.  All
of the violence you know exists down there seems as if it is a world away.

rooms.name: Western market street
rooms.desc:
Your standing on the main path through the southern section of the Elysium
town center.  Crystal and white marble constructs adorned with gold and silver
loom up all about you, shining light everywhere.  An occasional exotic tree
or bush sprouts up from the clouds beneath you, adding to the peaceful
atmosphere here.  To your south lies a large building where creatures
occasionally congregate, and to your north lies a curious looking crystal hut,
shining brighter than the others.

rooms.name: A sunny meadow
rooms.desc:
Your standing in a sunny meadow, light warming your body like a warm, spring
day.  Various wildflowers are in bloom, rising as high as your waist, while
an occasional bee alights upon a flower to sip of it's sweet nectar.  Not a 
cloud in the sky, as a butterfly flits about in the distance, completing this
beautiful, peaceful landscape.  In the distance, you hear the fall of water.

rooms.name: A tranquil room
rooms.desc:
A thin curtain of water falls serenely over the three white marble walls
opposite the entrance.  The clouds comprising the floor beneath your feet
almost seem alive as they slowly move in subtle waves, massaging your feet.
You feel at ease and incredibly comfortable, as you realize just how weary
an adventurer you are.

rooms.name: Hall of stories
rooms.desc:
A few members of various kinds of winged beasts congregate about the center
of the room, listening intently to Foosa's grand tales of adventure and
intrigue.  The large grand chamber has great acoustics, carrying all manner
of sounds and making the speaker's voice boom all about you.  The ideal
audience chamber.

rooms.name: A huge waterfall
rooms.desc:
From high above, a huge waterfall streams down to the ground, crashing onto
boulders resting in a small pond.  Light dances across the surface of the
water, creating golden light that shines on your face.  An occasional fish
comes to the surface of the pond to gulp of the sweet air, as you feel 
mesmerized by the grand natural serenity of the water and the falls.

rooms.name: A path around the Elysium Kingdom
rooms.desc:
The clouds beneath your feet are soft and give a little with each step, but
strangely still support you.  Looming before you is a huge crystal wall,
sparsely covered by exquisitely beautiful flowered vines, creating an aromatic
scent, mingling with a subtle light show created by the light refracting from
the pristine walls.  Small rivulets of water bead out in streams along the
path intermintently, and shower down to the ground, far far below.

rooms.name: Inside the Elysium Castle
rooms.desc:
Beneath your feet, the clouds supporting you and the castle seem as solid
as the earth.  Light shines preternaturally over all the structures here and
is refracted countless times creating a dizzingly bright lightshow effect.
Ordinarily, you'd want to shield your eyes from the glow, but you dare not
miss any part of quite possibly the most beautiful blend of architecture,
magic, and nature you've ever seen.

rooms.name: A spiral staircase
rooms.desc:
A large well-shaped room with walls of sheer crystal.  The light refracts
and bends here to the point of creating a prism effect, and casting the stairs
and room in a virtual rainbow of brilliant colors.  Stairs spiral upwards in
the colorful unknown.

rooms.name: Hanging gardens
rooms.desc:
Crystal walls loom up into the sky on each side of you, almost completely
covered in flowered vines.  Flowers and all manner of beautiful plants, some
of which you've never seen, line the ground and hang down around you like an
aromatic veil.

rooms.name: A clearing in the gardens
rooms.desc:
Exotic plants of all manner encase this area in a sort of room creating a
soothing sense of peace.  An occasional butterfly or two flutter by amid
flower petals carried loftily by a warm gentle breeze.  In the middle of this
area rests a multi-tiered fountain, glimmering in splendor under the sunlight.

rooms.name: Elysium town center north
rooms.desc:
Your standing on the main path through the northern section of the Elysium
town center.  Crystal and white marble constructs adorned with gold and silver
loom up all about you, shining light everywhere.  An occasional exotic tree
or bush sprouts up fromthe clouds beneath you, adding to the peaceful
atmosphere here.  East and west lie several buildings, north is a huge castle.

rooms.name: Before the Elysium Castle
rooms.desc:
Reaching even further into the sky, before you looms a castle of such huge
dimensions that you can't help but be awestruck.  White marble sculpted
sentinels watch from different points high up the crystal castle face, as
three towers disappear into the sky.  One part of the castle seems to tower
above all the others, and all seem to look to it in awe and reverence. Another
moat of open skies discourages swimming, and you are thankful for the 
drawbridge which allows you to cross.

town center.  Crystal and white marble constructs adorned with gold and silver
loom up all about you, shining light everywhere.  An occasional exotic tree
or bush sprouts up from the clouds beneath you, adding to the peaceful
atmosphere here.  North lies a nondescript hut.  To the south you faintly
hear the sounds of beautiful music.

rooms.name: Western market street
rooms.desc:
Your standing on the main path through the northern section of the Elysium
town center.  Crystal and white marble constructs adorned with gold and silver
loom up all about you, shining light everywhere.  An occasional exotic tree
or bush sprouts up from the clouds beneath you, adding to the peaceful
atmosphere here.  To your north lies a hut well stocked with various fruits.
South is a nondescript hut.

rooms.name: Produce shop
rooms.desc:
Colorful fruit of all sorts are stacked neatly in pristine displays.  The
fruit is spotless and seems to defy all manner of rot and disease.  As you
ponder this oddity, Shaldra flutters over in your direction to assist you in
your selection as you start to hunger for the exotic fruits before you.

rooms.name: A starry night
rooms.desc:
Your standing on a quaint looking path leading as far as the eye can see to
the south.  Above you, the heavens sprawl out, covering the sky, lights from
far away stars twinkling in the serene atmosphere.  In the distance, a cricket
or cicada chirps a peaceful song as fireflies flitter about, resembling
dancing yellow lights in the night sky.  The air is warm, inviting you to sit
and enjoy the peace and splendor of the starry night sky.

rooms.name: Eastern market street
rooms.desc:
Your standing on the main path through the northern section of the Elysium
town center.  Crystal and white marble constructs adorned with gold and silver
loom up all about you, shining light everywhere.  An occasional exotic tree
or bush sprouts up from the clouds beneath you, adding to the peaceful
atmosphere here.  North lies a huge building, and south there is a comforting
silence.

rooms.name: A reflecting pool
rooms.desc:
Small trees grow from the ground in the four corners of the room.  Around
the trees and covering the floor is a white marble floor, polished to the
point of faintly creating a reflective surface.  In the center of the room
is a large, shallow pool of water that you can see your reflection in.  Oddly,
you notice not only the reflection of your body, but you swear you can almost
see your soul reflected back at you as well.

rooms.name: A quiet room
rooms.desc:
This room seems to absorb all sound around you to create a stillness and
quiet.  Ordinarily such silence would be most unnerving, but for some reason,
you feel extremely at ease.  This room seems perfect for meditating...

rooms.name: Eastern market street
rooms.desc:
Your standing on the main path through the northern section of the Elysium
town center.  Crystal and white marble constructs adorned with gold and silver
loom up all about you, shining light everywhere.  An occasional exotic tree
or bush sprouts up from the clouds beneath you, adding to the peaceful
atmosphere here.  North lies a huge building, and south there is a small shop
advertising potions.

rooms.name: A crystal hut
rooms.desc:

abode.  Here, as in many other areas in the kingdom, teh clouds themselves
form a pillowy floor beneath your feet.  Off in one corner of the room is a 
secure see through area in the floor, showing the ground far far below.  All

rooms.name: Lardran's concoctions
rooms.desc:
All about you, various liquids of varying appearance and fluidity bubble
and flow through clear hoses and into and out of various glass containers.
An occasional fire is silently burning under some of the concoctions.  
Lardran looks at you with mild interest as he checks on the various potions.

rooms.name: Inside the Elysium castle
rooms.desc:
Goodness fills the air in these halls like a tangible curtain.  Warm light
shines everywhere, chasing shadows away, and giving emphasis to the gold and
silver objects of varying use and appearance that decorate the halls.  Here
and there is an occasional pillar of pure light, surounded by a lightly
golden hued water that trickles down from the lofty ceiling somewhere far
above.

rooms.name: Great hall south
rooms.desc:

shines everywhere, chasing shadows away, and giving emphasis to the gold and

rooms.name: A spacious room
rooms.desc:
The walls here glow with a dull, warm light.  Various sculptures of gold
and silver line the walls and glimmer with color.  A lush red carpet is laid
with care over the pristine white marble floors your standing on, which is
a welcome change from the cloud walking you partook in outside the castle.

rooms.name: A room
rooms.desc:
Light from the walls and even from the ceiling high above you shine light
everywhere, melting away all shadows and bathing you in a peaceful warmth and
tranquility.  More of the flowered vines from outside hang down about the 
walls here, carefully trimmed away from the masterfully constructed sculptures
of crystal, gold, silver, and white marble.

and room in a virtual rainbow of brilliant colors.  Stairs spiral upwards in
the colorful unknown.

rooms.name: A room
rooms.desc:
Light from the walls and even from the ceiling high above you shine light
everywhere, melting away all shadows and bathing you in a peaceful warmth and
tranquility.  More of the flowered vines from outside hang down about the 
walls here, carefully trimmed away from the masterfully constructed sculptures
of crystal, gold, silver, and white marble.

rooms.name: Top of the stairs
rooms.desc:
Your in a dimly lit room atop the stairs.  To your south, the room opens to
a vast, well lit, cavernous hall of beauty.  The hallway amazes you, either
out of opulence, or the thought of how wealthy and powerful even a small
portion of this could make you.

rooms.name: Hall of tranquility
rooms.desc:
Goodness fills the air in these halls like a tangible curtain.  Warm light
shines everywhere, chasing shadows away, and giving emphasis to the gold and
silver objects of varying use and appearance that decorate the halls.  Here
and there is an occasional pillar of pure light, surounded by a lightly
golden hued water that trickles down from the lofty ceiling somewhere far
above.

rooms.name: Atop the grand stairway
rooms.desc:
At the top of the stairs, you find yourself standing in an even larger hall
than the hall of tranquility.  A large red carpet made of an alien material,
blazes a path to your east.  The light from some unknown source shines warm
and bright all about you, making you shield your eyes from looking directly
at it.  A light wispy cloud floats by on a warm light breeze as the walls
themselves seem to glow and thrum with life.

rooms.name: Hall of promises
rooms.desc:
A large red carpet made of an alien material, blazes a path north to a large
audience chamber.  The light from some unknown source shines warm and bright
all about you.  A light wispy cloud floats by on a warm breeze, as the walls
themselves seem to glow and thrum with life.

rooms.name: The throne room
rooms.desc:
The walls in this grand chamber all glow with an inner life and upon closer
inspection, show images of all living creatures on the earth far far below.
From all manner of beasts, to other mortals trying to etch out a name for
themselves and attempting to become more powerful.  In wonderment, you start
to ponder the pettiness of personal gain and power in light of the 
tranquility and beauty here, but then again, you aren't perfect.  The
exquisite sculptures of the denizens of the castle decorate the open space
here between the large intricately patterned columns of crystal and light.
In paradise, you have found the room of royalty...

rooms.name: Treasury
rooms.desc:
Riches lie in heaps beyond imagining here.  Bahamut's bed itself is a huge
mountain of gold and gems.  To the dismay of the would be treasure hunter,
the gold seems to have melted into a huge amorphous blob, far far too large
for someone to ever hope of transporting it all away.  Despite the condition
of Bahamut's "bedding", some items lie about as either things that Bahamut
treasured for thier exotic nature, or perhaps for some other unknown reason...

rooms.name: A melodious room
rooms.desc:
Gentle music from unseen harps, chimes, drums, and other instruments create
a gentle, relaxing melody that almost seems catered just to you, to soothe
your troubles.  The opulent golden walls cause the music to reverberate to
higher pitches, as the clouds beneath your feet subtlely beat with a 
comforting bass.

rooms.name: A watchtower
rooms.desc:
From the parapet of this lofty tower, you can see for what looks like miles.
The vast blue sky resembles a sea of tranquility, as watchers make sure the
armies of darkness don't become foolhardy enough to attack Elysium.
